newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Democrats welcome bonds tax move.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Democrats welcome bonds tax move.

text.p: The Australian Democrats, a key bloc in parliament's upper house, on Friday welcomed the government's move to end the infrastructure bonds tax break.
Democrats leader Cheryl Kernot said in a statement the decision vindicated the party's long-term opposition to the scheme.
The government does not have a majority in the upper house Senate and needs to support of at least two non-government senators to pass legislation to abolish the tax break.
Treasurer Peter Costello earlier on Friday announced the end of the scheme after government studies found it was being exploited for tax minimisation.
Under the scheme, approved infrastructure developers could issue bonds on which interest was tax free.
Costello told reporters he expected the Democrats to support the move.
Kernot, welcoming the government's announcment, said the Democrats had warned for some time the tax break was open to abuse.
The government was considering a replacement scheme to foster infrastructure development.
